description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages for two metrics, MMAU and MMAR, across three different models: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni. The horizontal axis displays the model names in the order listed, while the vertical axis represents Accuracy (%) on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each model has two bars grouped side-by-side: the left bar is blue and represents MMAU, while the right bar is purple and represents MMAR. For Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, the MMAU accuracy is approximately 48%, and the MMAR accuracy is approximately 30%. For Audio-Reasoner, the MMAU accuracy is approximately 61%, and the MMAR accuracy is approximately 36%. For Qwen-2.5-Omni, the MMAU accuracy is approximately 64%, and the MMAR accuracy is approximately 57%. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the model names on the x-axis.
